_readme: قائمة المراجعة: كل نص فيه شبهة. ما انعرض شي منها على صاحب المشروع، تنتظر نهاية النقل. مطبّق=true يعني انكتب في المحتوى (والدرجة غير الواضحة مخفية من العرض)، وfalse يعني بقي من الموسوعة.

items.السبب: ما انلقى أو الراوي أو الدرجة ما طابقت
items.التفصيل: Found in Musnad al-Tayalisi 2400 (1456/2856), but the page has no editor's footnote and no grade by anyone; the only grade is HadeethEnc's own. Rule: a grade outside the two Sahihs needs a named grader.

items.التفصيل: Printed grade is Tirmidhi's «هذا حديث حسن صحيح», not plain «صحيح» as in the input. The text sits across a page break (marker ⦗٥٤٤⦘ after متفحشا), which made verify_quote return partial; the marker is excluded. Printed isnad: أبو عبد الله الجدلي says «سألت» عائشة. Ahmad not looked up.

items.التفصيل: Input wording (أنكحا ... وأنفقا) is not the printed wording in either Sahih; this is Bukhari 3472, same story and narrator, closest wording (Muslim 1721 has «وأنفقوا على أنفسكما منه وتصدقا»). verify_quote returned partial only because the printed page has a page-break marker ⦗١٧٥⦘ inside the hadith before «وتصدقا»; the marker is excluded from the text above.

items.التفصيل: narrator mismatch: the input is Anas's narration, but the printed Anas route (Tirmidhi 3525, 5/ 498, via Mu'ammal from Hammad from Humayd) is called by Tirmidhi «غريب وليس بمحفوظ» and he says Mu'ammal erred and the Hasan route is أصح; the input's own note says the hadith in Nasai and Ahmad is from Rabi'a ibn Amir, a different Companion. No sound grade for the Anas text found in the book.

items.التفصيل: In Sunan Abu Dawud 5200 the printed narration is mawquf on Abu Hurayra (no «قال رسول الله»); Arnaut's footnote says «المرفوع إسناده صحيح، والموقوف رجاله ثقات» (the marfu' is the previous hadith). The input presents it as marfu', so it is not matched.

items.التفصيل: Tirmidhi 2407: Tirmidhi says the mawquf route «أصح» and does not grade the marfu'; the Shakir footnote «حسن» names no grader; the Bashar edition (7895/4221–4222) has no footnote. No named grader for «صحيح».

items.التفصيل: The input attributes it to Ali ibn Abi Talib, but the Bukhari narration with this wording (page_id 8763, printed 7/ 154) is from Abu Hurayra («عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِذَا انْتَعَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ...»). Narrator differs, so not matched.

items.السبب: ما انلقى أو الراوي أو الدرجة ما طابقت
items.التفصيل: Found Muslim 947 (page_id 2130, printed 2/ 654) with matn «مَا مِنْ مَيِّتٍ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يَبْلُغُونَ مِائَةً…», but this edition prints the isnad as «عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بن يزيد رضيع عائشة، عن النبي ﷺ قَالَ» (Aisha is not named as the narrator; the page then adds a second route via أنس بن مالك). The input says narrator = Aisha, so the narrator cannot be confirmed from Shamela; decide manually.

items.التفصيل: Muslim 1628 (8): chain is three of Sa'd's sons narrating from their father (printed «عَنْ أَبِيهِ»); the text starts at «أَنّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَى سَعْدٍ يَعُودُهُ». Prayer «اللهم اشف سعدا» three times matches the input, but the input's first-person «عادني» is a paraphrase; the printed wording is third-person. Bukhari/Muslim 'عادني' versions (e.g. Muslim 3/ 1250, Bukhari 8/ 80) carry «اللهم اشف سعدا وأتمم له هجرته» once, not three times. Printed text has «اشْفِ سعد» (no diacritics) and «وإن تَأْكُلُ», copied as is.
